claim: Timing constants for 28 MHz code that include the cost of a NEXTREG 7 speed switch need the machine's own figure (a calibration), not an assumed one.

evidence.text: Constants holding NEXTREG 7,x need the machine's own figure (cw_cal); timed hooks use CW_X, cw_cal and lost-IRQ accounting.
evidence.quote: constants holding NEXTREG 7,x need the machine's own figure (cw_cal).
